title: Origin story: Ganesha
description: Ganesha was shaped by Parvati from turmeric paste to guard her door; when Shiva returned and was barred, he beheaded the boy in fury, then replaced the head with an elephant's to undo his grief. Made lord of beginnings, he is invoked before every venture, and wrote down the Mahabharata as Vyasa dictated.
